title: Total-limit equation for section-normalized reindexing composition
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of Q_l in universe u. Let A be a PodReindexFamily l E [def-pod-completion-reindex-coherence]. Write L_W for (podReindexCalculus l E W).reduction, R_W for coefficientSequenceLimit l E W, F_f for podOrdinaryReindex l E f, and P_f for integralComparisonDerivedSequencePullback l E f. Write alpha_f and beta_f for (A.completion f).reduction and .limit, kappa_(h,f) for A.compositionDerived l E h f, and sigma_(h,f) for integralComparisonSystemComposition l E h f [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems]. Assume PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E f (A.completion f) for every scheme isomorphism between schemes on which l is invertible [def-pod-completion-reindex-models]. Assume A.composition h f acts on every original local section by restriction along the inverse component of MorphismProperty.Over.mapComp h f. Then for every composable h:Z→W, f:W→V of such isomorphisms and every ambient system N in coefficientSequenceDerived l E V, kappa_(h,f)(R_V N) ≫ F_h(beta_f(N)) ≫ beta_h(P_f N) = beta_(h≫f)(N) ≫ R_Z(sigma_(h,f)(N)). No tensor, reduction-composition, identity-composition or completeness assumption is added.

proof.text: Represent the ambient system by a strict complex C. RestrictedGenerators pins the restricted-tower maps on all original sections to the actual adjunction-unit arrows. The normalized ordinary compositor and the unit normalization of the strict sequence compositor identify the two successive restricted maps with the composite map, including their tower transitions.

Evaluate the corresponding product maps after every projection: the two paths are the same restrictions along Over.mapComp. RoosFst and RoosSnd give equality of both coordinates, hence of the entire mapping-cocone chain maps. The intermediate Roos models agree on simultaneous K-injectives by their computes formulas; naturality gives their agreement on C. Substitute LimitModel, cancel model isomorphisms, and localize the whole chain-map identity. Natural localization factors give precisely the specified ordinary and system compositors. Transport along a representative isomorphism to every derived system.

theorem podReindexingCompositionLimit
    (A : PodReindexFamily l E)
    (hcompletion : ∀ {V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ W) [IsIso f]
      [∀ v : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField v)]
      [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)],
      PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E f (A.completion f))
    (hcomposition : ∀ {V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ W) (f : W ⟶ V)
      [IsIso h] [IsIso f] (M : scalarReductionSource l E V) (U : Z.ProEt)
      (x : M.val.obj (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose (h ≫ f)).obj U))),
      ((A.composition h f).hom.app M).val.app (op U) x =
        M.val.map ((MorphismProperty.Over.mapComp (Q := ⊤)
          (inferInstance : WeaklyEtale h) (inferInstance : WeaklyEtale f)).inv.app U).op x) :
    ∀ {V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ W) (f : W ⟶ V) [IsIso h] [IsIso f]
      [∀ v : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField v)]
      [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)]
      [∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)],
      ∀ N : coefficientSequenceDerived l E V,
        (A.compositionDerived l E h f).hom.app ((coefficientSequenceLimit l E V).obj N) ≫
          (podOrdinaryReindex l E h).map ((A.completion f).limit.hom.app N) ≫
          (A.completion h).limit.hom.app ((integralComparisonDerivedSequencePullback l E f).obj N) =
        (A.completion (h ≫ f)).limit.hom.app N ≫
          (coefficientSequenceLimit l E Z).map
            ((integralComparisonSystemComposition l E h f).hom.app N)
